SIGNED INFORMED CONSENT .HERE WE DISCUSS OUR INDIVIDUAL PATIENT'S PROBLEMS THROUGH SERIES OF INPUTS FROM AVAILABLE GLOBAL ONLINE COMMUNITY OF EXPERTS WITH AN AIM TO SOLVE THOSE CLINICAL PROBLEMS WITH COLLECTIVE CURRENT BEST EVIDENCE BASED INPUT.\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 29 year male came to opd with chief complaints of\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBilateral pain in lower limbs upto knee since 20 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHOPI\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 3 years ago then developed severe sudden pain in right lower abdomen for which he went to local hospital and was diagnosed to have renal calculus of 4 - 6 mm and got treated for it\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E6 months later patient developed pain in lower limbs bilaterally for which he visited a local doctor and was tested with high uric acid levels for which he got treated\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Efollowed by this he was intermittently having lower limb pain for which he was having acyclophenac whenever he was having episodes of pain\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESince 20 days pain wasn't reliving on medication and he got admitted to a local hospital. his creatinine levels were 8.2 for which he was referred to our hospital\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPast history\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;3 years ago he had lower abdomen pain diagnosed renal stones of 4 mm size - relieved on medication,\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a known case of diabetes , hypertension ,asthma ,tb,cardiovascular , diseases.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPersonal history\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet : mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite normal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep : inadequate due to pain since 20days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder movements regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo allergies\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOccasional alcohol consumption\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EChronic smoker since 6 years ( stopped 8 months back)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETREATMENT HISTORY\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/o usage of NSAIDs for pain since 2 yrs\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFAMILY HISTORY\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot significant\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneral examination\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was conscious coherent and cooperative\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EModerately built , moderately nourished\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPallor present\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo\u0026nbsp; icterus
